name: Nissan VQ35DE (350Z, 2003-2005 base engine)
summary: 60-degree DOHC 24-valve V6, even-firing. No factory cam timing or cylinder-to-bank numbering was found on an openable page; the Nissan service manual (EM section) was blocked.

rod_length_mm.note: Page gives connecting rod center distance 144.15-144.25 mm; motorreviewer.com also says 144.2 mm. Both are third-party spec sites, not Nissan documents.

compression_ratio.note: Page lists 10.0:1, 10.3:1 or 10.6:1 depending on version without saying which car gets which. 10.3 is recorded as the middle/early-350Z figure; a search-result summary of a forum post claimed 10.0:1 is the true figure (not opened). Treat as uncertain +/-0.3.

firing_order.note: Numbering convention and which cylinders sit on which bank were NOT found on any opened page. (A 1-2-3-4-5-6 order on a V6 implies alternating banks, i.e. odd numbers on one bank and even on the other, but that is an inference, not a sourced fact.)

crank.value: 60-degree V6; crank pin layout not documented on any opened page
crank.note: Even 120-degree firing is the normal result for a 60-degree V6 with six offset throws, but no opened page states the VQ35DE pin arrangement. Inference only.

firing_intervals_deg.note: Not stated on any opened page. Expected even 120 (inference).

intake_valve_dia_mm.note: Page gives 37.0-37.3 mm for early versions (36.6-36.9 mm later versions); midpoint recorded.

exhaust_valve_dia_mm.note: Page gives 31.2-31.5 mm for early versions (30.2-30.5 mm later versions); midpoint recorded.

intake_duration_deg.note: Listed on the page as 'Intake valve timing (intake valve timing control OFF): 1: 230, 2: 238, 3: 240' for three engine versions. Lift at which it is measured is NOT stated. Same page says the Rev-up cam is 248 degrees. Third-party site.

exhaust_duration_deg.note: Listed as 'Exhaust valve timing: 1: 232, 2: 240, 3: 240'. Measuring lift NOT stated.

intake_lift_mm.note: Not found on an opened page.

exhaust_lift_mm.note: Not found on an opened page.

variable_valve_timing.value: continuously variable intake cam phasing (CVTCS); exhaust fixed on this version

peak_power_kw.note: 287 hp at 6,200 rpm in the 350Z specification table (US rating). kW converted by me. Japanese Type E listed on the same page as 213.99 kW at 6,200 rpm.

peak_torque_nm.note: 274 lb-ft at 4,800 rpm; Nm converted by me (engine-specs.net gives 371 Nm as the family maximum). Japanese Type E: 363 Nm at 4,800.

redline_rpm.note: Base-engine redline not found on an opened page. motorreviewer.com gives the Rev-up version's rev limit as 7000 rpm.

missing: lift at which the 230/232 degree durations are measured

sources.what: Wikipedia, Nissan VQ engine. Bore, stroke, displacement, layout. Section is flagged as needing citations.
engine-specs.net VQ35DE page. Third-party compilation that reads like service-manual data (tolerance ranges); source of rod length, valve diameters, firing order, durations.
motorreviewer.com VQ35DE page. Third-party; confirms rod length 144.2 mm and Rev-up 7000 rpm limit.
Wikipedia, Nissan 350Z. Power and torque with rpm.

vehicle.name: Nissan 350Z base (Z33, US, 2003)

curb_kg.note: Forum transcription: 'Curb (pounds) MT 3,188 3,197 3,217 3,225 - 3,247' under Base / Enth / Perf / Track / Tour 5AT / Tour 6MT. carspecs.us Base manual (https://www.carspecs.us/cars/2003/nissan/350z/13216): 'Curb weight 3,188 lbs.' Converted by me (1446.0 kg). Standard not stated.

gears.note: 'Gear Ratio 1st ... Reverse M/T A/T 3.794 3.540 2.324 2.264 1.624 1.472 1.271 1.000 1.000 0.834 0.794 N/A 3.446 2.370' (manual first in each pair). carspecs.us Enthusiast manual (https://www.carspecs.us/cars/2003/nissan/350z/13214) rounds to 3.79 / 2.32 / 1.62 / 1.27 / 1.00 / 0.79.

final_drive.note: 'Final Drive Ratio 3.538 3.357' (manual / automatic). my350z (https://my350z.com/articles/2003-2009_nissan_350_z_spec_timeline_part_1/) gives 3.54 for the base.

wheel_radius_m.note: Calculated by me from the tyre size 235/50 R17 96W (rim diameter / 2 + section width x aspect ratio): unloaded geometric radius, not a published rolling radius.

tyre.note: 'Bridgestone Summer tires - Front 225/50R17 94W, Rear 235/50R17 96W' marked standard on Base, Enthusiast and Touring 5AT. Nissan's 2004 US release (https://usa.nissannews.com/en-US/releases/2004-nissan-350z-coupe) gives the same 17-inch sizes for the 2004 car.

driven.note: English Wikipedia, 'Nissan 350Z' (read 2026-11-17), infobox layout: Front mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive.

missing: a Nissan document for the 2003 base car's weight and ratios

sources.what: 350z-uk.com forum post (2010) transcribing a US specification table for 2003-2006 350Z trims: weights, gear ratios, final drives, wheels and tyres. Appears to be Nissan's sheet; forum source.
carspecs.us, 2003 Nissan 350Z Base coupé, 6-speed manual: curb weight. Dealer-data aggregator.
carspecs.us, 2003 350Z Enthusiast manual: rounded gear ratios, 3.54 final drive, 225/50 and 235/50 R17 tyres. Aggregator cross-check.
Nissan US press kit for the 2004 350Z: 17-inch tyre sizes. Different model year; cross-check.
